case-2:
A 15-second vertical (9:16) ultra-photorealistic close-up vlog clip, filmed on a phone held at arm's length. Not an ad. A girl talking to her own camera at the end of the day, the way people actually film themselves.
TALENT —
Young woman, early-to-mid 20s. Long light-brown hair with soft caramel balayage, middle part, loose undone waves, a few strands stuck to her cheek. Fair-to-light-tan skin with visible freckles across the nose and cheeks, thick natural brows, blue-green eyes, bare face, small blue resin hoop earrings, thin gold chain with a small pearl pendant. Face, freckles, hair and eye color must 100% match the reference. Oversized white linen button-down over a fitted white ribbed top, fully covered, collar slightly crooked, sleeves pushed up.
PRODUCT —
LANEIGE Water Sleeping Mask_EX, 70 ml. Frosted translucent light-blue glass jar, smooth matte cobalt-blue screw lid. Front label reads, in this exact order: "LANEIGE" in wide-spaced capitals, "WATER SLEEPING MASK_EX" below it, then "SLEEPING MICROBIOME" and "BRIGHTENING · HYDRATING · SOFTENING" in smaller pale-yellow type, then "70 ml" at the base. Inside, thick pale mint-blue gel with a wet glossy surface that holds a soft peak. Shape, color, gel texture and all label text must 100% match the reference, correctly spelled, legible whenever in focus.
LOCATION
A villa bedroom at golden hour. Only fragments read in frame because the camera is so tight: white stucco wall, a corner of rumpled white linen bedding, blurred bougainvillea and olive leaves through an open door behind her. The background stays soft and mostly out of focus the entire time.
LIGHTING
One condition, unchanged across all four beats. Low warm sun from frame-left through the open door, roughly 4800K, soft white-wall bounce filling the shadow side of her face. Warm rim on the left edge of her hair and jaw. Slight blown highlight where the sun clips her cheek. No ring light, no fill, no glam lighting.
FRAMING
Close-up throughout. Her face fills most of the frame in every beat, chin to just above the hairline, never wider than upper-chest. The jar enters frame close to her face, never held out toward the lens.
0:00–0:04
Visual: Tight front-camera close-up, slightly below eye level. She's mid-motion already, pushing hair off her face with the back of her wrist. She glances just off-lens, checking her own image, then back. The jar comes up beside her cheek, held low and casual, only the top half in frame, lid already off. A slow exhale through the nose.
Camera: Selfie camera, arm's length, natural handheld drift, one quick autofocus hunt between her face and the jar.
Dialogue: "Okay. Last thing, then bed."
0:04–0:07
Visual: She tips the jar slightly and drags two fingertips through the gel. Macro-tight: her fingertips, the wet mint-blue surface, a fine thread of gel stretching and snapping. The "LANEIGE" and "WATER SLEEPING MASK_EX" lines cross the frame in focus for a beat. Her face stays partly in frame at the edge, out of focus.
Camera: Same front camera pushed in close, shallow focus, rack from the label to the gel on her fingers.
Dialogue: "It's cold, by the way."
0:07–0:11
Visual: Back to her face, closer now. She taps the gel across one cheek, her forehead, her chin, then presses it in flat-palmed, working outward. The gel flashes milky over her skin, then settles clear with a faint sheen. She winces at the cold, blinks it off, keeps going. Freckles, pores and natural under-eye shadows stay visible right through the layer. She's talking while working, not pausing for the line.
Camera: Selfie camera, very close, small handheld corrections, a slow drift as she turns her cheek toward the light.
Dialogue: "Thin layer. You don't wash it off."
0:11–0:15
Visual: Closest framing of the clip. She presses two fingertips against her cheek and lets them lift, feeling the faint tack. Turns her head slowly through the low sun, checking the sheen along her cheekbone, eyes tracking her own reflection in the screen rather than the lens. A short nod. The corner of the blue jar sits soft-focus in the lower frame edge, label partly readable. She reaches to stop the recording and the frame tilts as her hand moves.
Camera: Selfie camera, slow handheld orbit from three-quarter profile to straight-on, ending on her face filling the frame, then a small tilt as she reaches.
Dialogue: "Morning me is gonna be so happy."
PERFORMANCE
End-of-day, low energy, unperformed. She talks the way someone talks while doing something else, lines half-thrown-away, not projected. Micro-behavior carries the beats: a slow blink, a genuine flinch at the cold, a half-smile that arrives late, eyes checking her own reflection instead of the lens, one natural swallow, visible breath, a small unconscious head tilt. No presenter voice, no bright delivery, no exaggerated reactions, no pointing at the product.
VOICE
Soft, slightly flat, close to the mic because the phone is at arm's length. Natural room tone around it. Unhurried, a little tired. Ordinary speaking volume with a touch of breath on the ends of words.
REALISM
Pore-level skin realism: visible pores across the nose and cheeks, fine forehead texture, natural freckling, faint under-eye shadows, a small blemish near the jaw, stray flyaway hairs catching the backlight, vellus hair on the cheek edge. Wet living eyes with catch-lights and natural asymmetric blinking. The gel reads as a real cosmetic layer refracting light on top of her skin, never replacing its texture.
PHYSICS
Gel holds a soft peak on her fingertip and slumps under pressure. Hair moves with real inertia and a few strands fall back across her face. Linen creases and drapes naturally. The jar has real weight and correct contact shadow against her hand. Camera weight shifts naturally with her arm.
CAMERA CHARACTER
Authentic modern smartphone selfie footage. Natural handheld tremor throughout, small framing corrections, quick autofocus hunts, mild wide-angle distortion at close range, natural rolling shutter, real motion blur, slight sensor noise in the shadow side. Never feels stabilized or operated by anyone else.
STYLE
Real personal vlog, iPhone-shot look, high-end photorealistic quality. Warm golden-hour daylight, real ambient evening atmosphere, no retouching, no skin smoothing, no product-hero framing, no before/after transformation, no commercial polish.
OUTPUT SETTINGS
9:16 vertical. 15 seconds. Real-time motion. High-detail photorealistic 8K intent. Natural smartphone motion blur and subtle sensor noise.
POSITIVE LOCKS
 keeps the same face, freckles, hair, earrings, necklace and white linen shirt over white ribbed top in every beat, fully covered throughout.
 stays the same frosted blue jar with matte cobalt lid, correct one-hand size, label text correctly spelled and legible whenever in focus, sharpest in the 0:04–0:07 beat.
Exactly two arms and two hands visible, anatomically correct with five fingers, one hand always holding the phone.
Same room, same wardrobe, same golden-hour lighting from first frame to last.
Close-up framing held throughout, her face dominant in every beat.
Spoken dialogue exactly as written, in order, at the stated timings, with accurate natural lip-sync.
Natural ambient audio only: faint breeze, distant birds, the small click of the lid, room tone. No music, no on-screen text, no captions, no subtitles, no logos other than the product's own packaging.
extra-da037dc76f9b:
Multi-shot sequence with hard cuts between shots. Keep the same characters, cat, environments and visual style throughout. No music or score — only natural diegetic sound.
SHOT 1
A dirty, exhausted 18-year-old girl with dark auburn-brown hair in a messy low ponytail, warm brown eyes, faded olive-green military jacket, backpack and gloves, holds a bolt-action rifle inside an abandoned ornate mansion. Sweat, dirt, a cheek scrape and tears cover her face. Her hands tremble. She closes her eyes as a tear rolls down her cheek, then hears a faint sound and slowly lowers the rifle, visibly heartbroken.
SHOT 2
Over her shoulder, an infected golden-orange tabby cat sits weakly on the debris-covered parquet floor. Its fur is dirty and matted, eyes cloudy and pale, with small wounds and dark infected veins visible beneath its fur. The cat trembles and lets out a soft, frightened meow.
SHOT 3
She slowly crouches beside the cat, carefully places the rifle on the floor, wipes her tears and gives it a small broken smile. She quietly speaks to the cat in a gentle voice, reaches into her jacket and pulls out a small worn red toy mouse. She gently places it on the floor and nudges it toward the cat.
SHOT 4
Extreme low-angle close-up of the small red toy mouse sliding slowly through dust across the cracked parquet floor. It stops directly in front of the cat's paws. The cat looks down at it. Hold on the still toy and the cat's trembling paws.
HARD CUT / TRANSFORMATION
SHOT 5
Same low camera angle and exact toy position, but now on a clean sunny residential basketball court. A healthy golden-orange tabby cat suddenly reaches forward and grabs the toy mouse. Its eyes are clear and warm, fur clean and fluffy, movements energetic and playful. The cat bats the toy around excitedly.
SHOT 6
Wide shot of the basketball court. The woman gently tosses the toy mouse across the court. The happy cat runs after it, pounces on it, plays with it, then runs back toward her and drops the toy at her feet, ready to play again.
SHOT 7
Close-up of the clean, unharmed woman laughing warmly while affectionately scratching the cat behind its ears and gently rubbing its neck. The cat purrs, leans against her hand and happily flicks its tail.
SHOT 8
Wide peaceful shot. The woman and cat sit together beside a pristine dark-green vintage convertible parked beside the basketball court. She sits on the ground beside the car, opens a small tin of cat food and gently feeds the cat. The cat eats peacefully, then rubs its head against her hand. She smiles and gently strokes its back.
CONSISTENCY
Same woman throughout: dark auburn-brown hair, loose low ponytail, warm brown eyes, olive-green military jacket, khaki cargo pants and brown boots.
Same cat throughout: golden-orange tabby coat, distinctive facial markings, same eye shape, same body size and proportions. Infected, injured and frightened in the mansion; completely healthy, clean, playful and energetic after the transformation.
MANSION
Abandoned ornate interior, tall arched windows, torn dark-red curtains, peeling damask wallpaper, shattered gilt mirror, broken furniture, debris, ceiling hole and strong sunlight beams cutting through dusty air.
COURT
Clean residential basketball court, white lines, iron fence, flowering shrubs, stone townhouses, warm late-afternoon sunlight and soft natural shadows. Dark-green vintage convertible with chrome trim.
VISUAL STYLE
Ultra-realistic, photorealistic live-action, natural human and animal movement, handheld camera, shallow depth of field, ARRI Alexa 35 look, warm cinematic grade, subtle film grain. Hard cuts between shots. The transformation must feel instantaneous and visually seamless, with the toy mouse and camera position matching precisely across the cut.

Made with seedance 2.5

Prompt 👇 
1. A cute chubby toddler boy, around 2–3 years old, with fair skin, huge expressive green eyes, short golden-blond hair with a small curled tuft on top, rosy cheeks, and a mischievous smile. He wears a bright yellow one-piece pajama covered with tiny orange duck patterns and a blue zipper.
2. His father, a friendly middle-aged man with neatly styled dark-brown hair, thick eyebrows, round black glasses, a large brown mustache, and a warm but slightly strict expression. He wears a light-blue shirt with a darker blue sweater vest and brown pants.

Environment:
A bright, playful kindergarten classroom filled with pastel colors. Rainbow decorations, colorful clouds, stars, alphabet blocks, children's tables and chairs, toys, teddy bears, large windows, and soft warm daylight. The entire environment should feel cheerful, whimsical, safe, and child-friendly.

Animation and story:
Start with the toddler standing confidently in the classroom with a mischievous expression while his father stands behind him. The father looks suspicious and points toward the child as if questioning him.

The toddler looks up at his father with an innocent expression and answers confidently. The father becomes more suspicious and asks whether the child has been eating sugar.

The toddler tries to deny it while smiling mischievously. Show a close-up of the toddler laughing with his eyes closed, revealing tiny teeth and a playful expression.

Cut back to the father and toddler together. The father raises one finger and questions him about telling lies.

Then the father leans closer toward the toddler and gestures toward the child's mouth, telling him to open his mouth.

End with an extreme close-up of the toddler laughing uncontrollably with eyes closed and a huge innocent smile while colorful confetti/star shapes appear around him.

Visual style:
High-end 3D animated children's movie quality, Pixar-inspired level of polish without copying any specific copyrighted character, soft rounded character design, oversized expressive eyes, adorable facial expressions, smooth skin shading, detailed clothing, vibrant pastel colors, soft global illumination, cinematic depth of field, volumetric lighting, glossy yet natural materials, beautiful subsurface scattering, clean character animation.

Camera:
Use dynamic cinematic camera movements with medium shots, close-ups, and expressive reaction shots. Smooth dolly-in movements, gentle camera transitions, shallow depth of field during close-ups, and stable framing. Keep the toddler's face highly expressive and clearly visible.

Facial animation:
Strong lip-sync, natural blinking, eyebrow movement, eye direction changes, cheek movement, smiling, laughing, surprised expressions, and exaggerated children's cartoon emotions.

Motion:
Smooth professional 3D character animation, natural hand gestures, believable body movement, subtle head movements, expressive pointing and reactions. Avoid stiff animation or unnatural movements.

Lighting:
Warm soft daylight coming through classroom windows, colorful ambient bounce light, soft shadows, subtle rim lighting, bright cheerful atmosphere.

Audio:
Cute child voice for the toddler, warm male father voice, playful children's background music, subtle classroom ambience, expressive comedic timing, clear dialogue and accurate lip synchronization.

Dialogue timing:
Father: “Johnny, Johnny!”
Toddler: “Yes, Papa?”
Father: “Eating sugar?”
Toddler: “No, Papa!”
Father: “Telling lies?”
Toddler: “No, Papa!”
Father: “Open your mouth!”
Toddler: [laughs]

Overall mood:
Funny, adorable, innocent, playful, highly engaging children's animation with exaggerated facial expressions and comedic timing.

Output:
Ultra-detailed 3D animation, 9:16 vertical format, 4K quality, smooth motion, cinematic composition, consistent character identity throughout the entire video, professional children's animation, polished rendering.
